    11	/-!
    12	# Intrinsic theta restrictions on widened divisor-family pieces
    13	
    14	The widened cover of `AffAdaptation` consists of arbitrary affine opens.  It therefore
    15	cannot use a pinned-chart trivialization of the theta cocycle.  Instead, on each piece
    16	`D.pieces j` we choose the affine sections model of the intrinsic cocycle-glued theta
    17	line bundle `(thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf`.  Its sections are an invertible module
    18	over the piece ring.
    19	
    20	Base change along the quotient
    21	`Gamma(D.pieces j) -> A.colength j = Gamma(D.pieces j) / (A.eqn j)` gives the intrinsic
    22	restriction of the theta line bundle to the piece of the finite divisor.  Invertibility
    23	is preserved by this base change.  A widened certificate then makes the colength algebra
    24	finite projective over `R`, so the existing invertible-module transfer gives finite and
    25	projective `R`-modules without any chart typing or additional hypothesis.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace
    33	open scoped TensorProduct
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	
    39	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    40	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    41	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    42	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    43	
    44	namespace AffAdaptation
    45	
    46	/-- The intrinsic theta sections on the widened affine piece `j`. -/
    47	noncomputable abbrev ThetaPieceSections (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    48	    (j : D.index) : Type u :=
    49	  (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf.obj.obj (op (D.pieces j))
    50	
    51	/-- A canonical choice of the finite projective invertible sections model of the
    52	intrinsic theta line bundle on the widened affine piece `j`.  The choice internally
    53	refines the arbitrary piece by basic opens subordinate to the theta cover; it does not
    54	type the piece itself into either pinned chart. -/
    55	noncomputable def thetaPieceSectionsModel (_A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    56	    (thetaChartDatum C R π a).AffineSectionsModel (D.pieces j) :=
    57	  Classical.choice ((thetaChartDatum C R π a).nonempty_affineSectionsModel

    59	
    60	/-- The piece-ring action on intrinsic theta sections selected by
    61	`thetaPieceSectionsModel`. -/
    62	@[reducible]
    63	noncomputable def thetaPieceSectionsModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    64	    Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    65	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf (D.pieces j) :=
    66	    (A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a j).qcoh
    67	  Scheme.QcohOn.moduleOfLE (F := (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf)
    68	    (le_refl (D.pieces j))
    69	
    70	/-- The intrinsic restriction of `O(a Theta)` to the divisor inside the widened piece
    71	`j`: tensor theta sections with the equation quotient `A.colength j`. -/
    72	noncomputable abbrev ThetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    73	    (j : D.index) : Type u :=
    74	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    75	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
    76	  A.colength j ⊗[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)] A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j

    78	/-- The intrinsic theta restriction is invertible over the piece-local colength algebra.
    79	This is base-change stability of invertible modules. -/
    80	theorem invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    81	    Module.Invertible (A.colength j) (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
    82	  let M := A.thetaPieceSectionsModel (π := π) a j
    83	  letI : Scheme.QcohOn (thetaChartDatum C R π a).sheaf (D.pieces j) := M.qcoh
    84	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    85	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
    86	  haveI : Module.Invertible Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)
    87	      (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) := M.invertible
    88	  change Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
    89	    (A.colength j ⊗[Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)]
    90	      A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j)

    93	/-- Under the existing widened certificate, every intrinsic theta restriction is finite
    94	over the test ring. -/
    95	theorem IsCertified.finite_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) {n : ℕ}
    96	    (hc : A.IsCertified n) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
    97	    Module.Finite R (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
    98	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
    99	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   100	  haveI : Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
   101	      (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) :=
   102	    A.invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j
   103	  haveI : Module.Finite R (A.colength j) := hc.finite_colength j
   104	  exact Module.Invertible.finite_trans (A := A.colength j)
   105	
   106	/-- Under the existing widened certificate, every intrinsic theta restriction is
   107	projective over the test ring. -/
   108	theorem IsCertified.projective_thetaPieceRestriction (A : AffAdaptation D d) {n : ℕ}
   109	    (hc : A.IsCertified n) (a : ℕ) (j : D.index) :
   110	    Module.Projective R (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) := by
   111	  letI : Module Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) (A.ThetaPieceSections (π := π) a j) :=
   112	    A.thetaPieceSectionsModule (π := π) a j
   113	  haveI : Module.Invertible (A.colength j)
   114	      (A.ThetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j) :=
   115	    A.invertible_thetaPieceRestriction (π := π) a j
   116	  haveI : Module.Projective R (A.colength j) := hc.projective_colength j
   117	  exact Module.Invertible.projective_trans (A := A.colength j)
   118

    12	/-!
    13	# Invertible sections of a cocycle-glued line bundle on an affine open
    14	
    15	The cocycle pieces used to construct `gluedSheaf` need not contain an arbitrary affine
    16	open.  Nevertheless, every affine open admits a finite basic-open refinement subordinate
    17	to the canonical pointed cover by those pieces.  On each refined basic open the glued
    18	sheaf is free of rank one.  The existing localization-span engine then proves that its
    19	sections on the original affine open are finite projective.
    20	
    21	`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.AffineSectionsModel` packages the quasi-coherent action chosen by
    22	that internal refinement together with the finite, projective, and invertible instances.
    23	Returning a `Nonempty` model keeps the refinement choice noncomputable while giving
    24	downstream code a single datum from which it can install all four compatible instances.
    25	
    26	This is the chart-free line-bundle substrate needed to restrict a positive theta twist to
    27	the arbitrary affine pieces of `AffAdaptation`: the divisor cover is not required to lie in
    28	either pinned theta chart.
    29	-/

   336	/-! ## The equalizer algebra and the unit-twisted glued modules
   337	
   338	Everything in this section is **cover-generic**: it names `D.pieces`, `A.ovlIdeal`,
   339	`A.toOvlLeft/Right` and nothing about a chart, so it ports from
   340	`Picard/DivisorFamilyThetaRank.lean:77-231` with `AffAdaptation` in place of
   341	`DivisorAdaptation` and no other change.  It is the substrate a widened `IsThetaPaired` —
   342	the honest cohomological residue of the (c2)-transport — is stated over. -/
   343	
   344	/-- **The equalizer algebra `A_D` over a widened cover**: the glued colength module is an
   345	`R`-subalgebra of the piece product, because the overlap-restriction arrows are algebra
   346	maps. -/
   347	noncomputable def gluedSubalgebra : Subalgebra R A.chartProd where
   348	  carrier := A.gluedSubmodule
   349	  add_mem' := fun hx hy => A.gluedSubmodule.add_mem hx hy
   350	  mul_mem' := by
   351	    intro x y hx hy
   352	    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_gluedSubmodule_iff] at hx hy ⊢
   353	    intro p
   354	    rw [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.mul_apply, map_mul, map_mul, hx p, hy p]
   355	  one_mem' := by
   356	    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_gluedSubmodule_iff]
   357	    intro p
   358	    rw [Pi.one_apply, Pi.one_apply, map_one, map_one]
   359	  algebraMap_mem' := by
   360	    intro r
   361	    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_gluedSubmodule_iff]
   362	    intro p
   363	    rw [Pi.algebraMap_apply, Pi.algebraMap_apply, AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes]
   364	
   365	lemma mem_gluedSubalgebra_iff {x : A.chartProd} :
   366	    x ∈ gluedSubalgebra A ↔ x ∈ A.gluedSubmodule :=
   367	  Iff.rfl
   368	
   369	/-- The equalizer algebra and the glued module have the same carrier, `R`-linearly. -/
   370	noncomputable def gluedSubalgebraEquiv : ↥(gluedSubalgebra A) ≃ₗ[R] A.Glued where
   371	  toFun x := ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
   372	  invFun x := ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
   373	  map_add' _ _ := rfl
   374	  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
   375	  left_inv _ := rfl
   376	  right_inv _ := rfl

   378	section UnitTwist
   379	
   380	variable (u v : ∀ i j : D.index, Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)ˣ)
   381	
   382	/-- The `u`-twisted right overlap arrow for an arbitrary unit family on the piece
   383	overlaps. -/
   384	noncomputable def unitDeltaRight : A.chartProd →ₗ[R] A.ovlProd :=
   385	  LinearMap.pi (fun p : D.index × D.index =>
   386	    LinearMap.mulLeft R (Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal p.1 p.2)
   387	        ((u p.1 p.2 : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2)ˣ) :
   388	          Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2))) ∘ₗ
   389	      (A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj p.2)
   390	
   391	/-- The `u`-twisted glued colength module. -/
   392	noncomputable def unitGluedSubmodule : Submodule R A.chartProd :=
   393	  LinearMap.ker (A.deltaLeft - unitDeltaRight A u)
   394	
   395	/-- The `u`-twisted equalizer description. -/
   396	lemma mem_unitGluedSubmodule_iff (s : A.chartProd) :
   397	    s ∈ unitGluedSubmodule A u ↔ ∀ p : D.index × D.index,
   398	      A.toOvlLeft p.1 p.2 (s p.1)
   399	        = Ideal.Quotient.mk (A.ovlIdeal p.1 p.2)
   400	            ((u p.1 p.2 : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2)ˣ) :
   401	              Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2))
   402	          * A.toOvlRight p.1 p.2 (s p.2) := by
   403	  simp only [unitGluedSubmodule, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero,
   404	    funext_iff, deltaLeft, unitDeltaRight, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp,
   405	    Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply,
   406	    LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
   407	
   408	/-- At the trivial unit family, the twisted glued module is the glued module. -/
   409	lemma unitGluedSubmodule_one : unitGluedSubmodule A 1 = A.gluedSubmodule := by
   410	  ext s
   411	  rw [mem_unitGluedSubmodule_iff, mem_gluedSubmodule_iff]
   412	  refine forall_congr' fun p => ?_
   413	  rw [Pi.one_apply, Pi.one_apply, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul]
   414	
   415	/-- At the Θ unit family, the twisted glued module is the widened `W(d)^{Θᵃ}` — by `rfl`,
   416	exactly as chart-typed, which is what lets the pairing layer be stated over `thetaOvlUnit`
   417	without a transport. -/
   418	lemma unitGluedSubmodule_thetaOvlUnit :
   419	    unitGluedSubmodule A (thetaOvlUnit τ a) = thetaGluedSubmodule A τ a :=
   420	  rfl

   422	variable {u v}
   423	
   424	/-- **Twists multiply**: the componentwise product of a `u`-twisted and a `v`-twisted glued
   425	family is `(u * v)`-twisted. -/
   426	theorem mul_mem_unitGluedSubmodule {s t : A.chartProd}
   427	    (hs : s ∈ unitGluedSubmodule A u) (ht : t ∈ unitGluedSubmodule A v) :
   428	    s * t ∈ unitGluedSubmodule A (u * v) := by
   429	  rw [mem_unitGluedSubmodule_iff] at hs ht ⊢
   430	  intro p
   431	  have h1 : (s * t) p.1 = s p.1 * t p.1 := rfl
   432	  have h2 : (s * t) p.2 = s p.2 * t p.2 := rfl
   433	  have h3 : (((u * v) p.1 p.2 : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2)ˣ) :
   434	      Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2))
   435	      = ((u p.1 p.2 : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2)ˣ) :
   436	          Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2))
   437	        * ((v p.1 p.2 : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2)ˣ) :
   438	          Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces p.1 ⊓ D.pieces p.2)) := rfl
   439	  rw [h1, h2, h3, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, hs p, ht p]
   440	  ring
   441	
   442	variable (u) in
   443	/-- The `u`-twisted glued module as a module over the equalizer algebra `A_D`. -/
   444	noncomputable def unitGluedOver : Submodule ↥(gluedSubalgebra A) A.chartProd where
   445	  carrier := unitGluedSubmodule A u
   446	  add_mem' := fun hx hy => (unitGluedSubmodule A u).add_mem hx hy
   447	  zero_mem' := (unitGluedSubmodule A u).zero_mem
   448	  smul_mem' := by
   449	    intro c x hx
   450	    have hc : (c : A.chartProd) ∈ unitGluedSubmodule A 1 := by
   451	      rw [unitGluedSubmodule_one]
   452	      exact c.2
   453	    have hmul := mul_mem_unitGluedSubmodule A hc hx
   454	    rw [one_mul] at hmul
   455	    have hsmul : c • x = (c : A.chartProd) * x := Algebra.smul_def c x
   456	    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hsmul]
   457	    exact hmul
   458	
   459	lemma mem_unitGluedOver_iff {x : A.chartProd} :
   460	    x ∈ unitGluedOver A u ↔ x ∈ unitGluedSubmodule A u :=
   461	  Iff.rfl

   463	end UnitTwist

   465	/-! ## The manufactured sections, side-uniformly
   466	
   467	`DivisorAdaptation.thetaSectionFst/Snd` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyThetaSections.lean:271/:278`)
   468	are the two sections `σ = (t₀ᵃ; 1)`, `τ = (1; t₁ᵃ)` whose pairing discharges
   469	`IsThetaPaired` chart-typed.  They read the `Sum` index to decide *which side's coordinate
   470	to use on this piece* — and that decision is again a `Bool`, so the side-uniform coordinate
   471	below carries them to the widened cover. -/
   472	
   473	section Sections
   474	
   475	/-- **The side-uniform coordinate power** `t_bᵃ` on the pinned chart of side `b`: `t₀ᵃ` on
   476	`false`, `t₁ᵃ` on `true`.  The `Bool`-indexed form of `relFiberCoordPow` /
   477	`relFiberCoordOnePow`, which the widened sections need for the same reason
   478	`relThetaResSide` was needed for the twisting unit. -/
   479	noncomputable def relFiberCoordSidePow (n : ℕ) : ∀ b : Bool,
   480	    Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b)
   481	  | false => relFiberCoordPow C R π n
   482	  | true => relFiberCoordOnePow C R π n
   483	
   484	@[simp]
   485	lemma relFiberCoordSidePow_false (n : ℕ) :
   486	    relFiberCoordSidePow (C := C) (R := R) (π := π) n false
   487	      = relFiberCoordPow C R π n := rfl
   488	
   489	@[simp]
   490	lemma relFiberCoordSidePow_true (n : ℕ) :
   491	    relFiberCoordSidePow (C := C) (R := R) (π := π) n true
   492	      = relFiberCoordOnePow C R π n := rfl
   493	
   494	/-- **The widened manufactured section at side `b`**: on each piece, the coordinate power of
   495	its *assigned* side when that side is `b`, and `1` otherwise.
   496	
   497	At `b = false` this is `thetaSectionFst` and at `b = true` it is `thetaSectionSnd`, with the
   498	`Sum`-match replaced by a `Bool` comparison against `τ.side j`. -/
   499	noncomputable def thetaSectionSide (b : Bool) : A.chartProd := fun j =>
   500	  if h : τ.side j = b then
   501	    Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j})
   502	      ((relCurve C R).resHom (piece_le_relPinnedChart τ j)
   503	        (h ▸ relFiberCoordSidePow (C := C) (R := R) (π := π) a (τ.side j)))
   504	  else 1
   505	
   506	@[simp]
   507	lemma thetaSectionSide_of_side_eq {b : Bool} {j : D.index} (h : τ.side j = b) :
   508	    thetaSectionSide A τ a b j
   509	      = Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {A.eqn j})
   510	          ((relCurve C R).resHom (piece_le_relPinnedChart τ j)
   511	            (h ▸ relFiberCoordSidePow (C := C) (R := R) (π := π) a (τ.side j))) :=
   512	  dif_pos h
   513	
   514	@[simp]
   515	lemma thetaSectionSide_of_side_ne {b : Bool} {j : D.index} (h : τ.side j ≠ b) :
   516	    thetaSectionSide A τ a b j = 1 :=
   517	  dif_neg h
   518	
   519	end Sections

    12	/-!
    13	# The Θ-LAYER OVER A CHART-TYPED WIDENED COVER: a real absence, on an index that R2 empties
    14	
    15	> **READ `isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling` (below) BEFORE THIS DOCSTRING'S ARGUMENT.**
    16	> This module's original headline was "the widened carrier had no Θ-layer, and supplying it lets
    17	> cert-r2's producer reach U2". **The first clause is true; the second is refuted, in Lean, in
    18	> this file.** Every declaration here is indexed by a `ChartTyping C R π D`, and a cover with a
    19	> straddling piece admits *none* — which is exactly the case protection `I-0492`'s widening
    20	> exists to handle. So on those divisors every theorem below is vacuous, and the tree's only
    21	> `ChartTyping` producer is the migration *from* the old chart-typed carrier. Refutation and its
    22	> consequences: `isEmpty_chartTyping_of_straddling`; reviewer items `I-0779`/`I-0782`.
    23	>
    24	> What survives is worth keeping and is not the headline: the Θ-layer genuinely did not exist on
    25	> `AffAdaptation` (measurements below, independently confirmed as `I-0780`), it ports cleanly, and
    26	> it is now available for any cover that *does* carry a chart typing.
    27	
    28	Protection `I-0492` widened the certificate carrier to arbitrary affine opens, and the
    29	widened lane now produces a class from geometry
    30	(`ThetaGeneratorSeed.divFamZarAff_of_swallowing_affineOpen`,
    31	`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffSeedGate.lean`).  That producer still cannot feed U2, and the
    32	reason recorded across five sessions — "U2 needs a certificate" — is **not** it.  The
    33	argument below correctly identifies the *absence*; where it overreaches is in treating
    34	supplying that absence as sufficient.
    35	
    36	## The measurement that renames the seam
    37	
    38	U2's consumer `DivRepChartFamily.IsChartClause` (`Picard/DivRepAffPullClause.lean:121`)
    39	quantifies over `DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) π g`, the *chart-typed* value.  There is no
    40	map `DivFamZarAff → DivFamZar` and there cannot be (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2:
    41	a straddling divisor has no chart-typed certificate).  So the only usable route is to
    42	re-derive the ε-value facts on the widened carrier — and *that* is where the absence is:
    43	
    44	> `divFamEps_eq_of_le` (`Picard/DivRepChartClassUnivQuot.lean`) needs projectivity and
    45	> constant rank `g` of the **window quotient**.  On `DivFam` those are landed
    46	> *unconditionally* (`Picard/DivSchemeFrameCover.lean:106`/`:117`) — but their only proof
    47	> route is `windowQuotEquiv` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyWindow.lean:179`), whose target is
    48	> `A.ThetaGlued a`, and `ThetaGlued` / `thetaGluedEval` / `thetaOvlUnit` /
    49	> `thetaDeltaRight` / `ker_thetaGluedEval` are defined **only** on `DivisorAdaptation`
    50	> (`Picard/DivisorFamilyTheta.lean`).
    51	
    52	Cross-measured at HEAD: of the files mentioning `AffAdaptation`, **zero** define any theta
    53	arrow.  `DivisorFamilyAffFraming.lean` is right that the ε-pair *statement* is
    54	carrier-indifferent (both carriers have the same `eqns` field and `divisorWindow` reads
    55	nothing else); the ε-pair **facts** are not, and statement was never separated from facts.
    56	
    57	## Why this is a port and not new mathematics
    58	
    59	The Θ-layer's chart-dependence is exactly **one `Bool` per piece**.  `FinCoverData`'s
    60	version reads it off the `Sum` index (`pieces_inl_le` / `pieces_inr_le`), which is why it
    61	looks chart-typed; but the side-uniform API it could have used already exists and is
    62	consumed by some sixty files:
    63	
    64	* `relThetaResSide` (`Picard/DivSchemeFamilySide.lean:155`) — the side component,
    65	  restricted into any open below `relPinnedChart (side j)`;
    66	* `relThetaSideUnit` (`:180`) — the matching unit of an ordered pair of sides, whose
    67	  four-case split *is* `FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit`'s;
    68	* `relThetaResSide_matching` (`:194`) and `resHom_relThetaResSide` (`:172`).
    69	
    70	Each needs only `piece ≤ relPinnedChart (side j)` — which is **verbatim** the field
    71	`ChartTyping.piece_le` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean:204`), the datum `I-0492`
    72	clause 3 deliberately kept *separate* from the certificate clauses precisely so the
    73	Θ-layer could have it without the certificate demanding it.
    74	
    75	So this file is the missing face, built the way clause 3 intends: the twisting data is
    76	indexed by a `ChartTyping`, and **no certificate clause and no locally-certified predicate
    77	mentions it**.
    78	
    79	## What this file does and does not claim
    80	
    81	It builds the widened Θ-twisted glued module and its evaluation, and proves the kernel
    82	bridge — left exactness, i.e. that the kernel is the *same* cover-independent vanishing
    83	submodule the chart-typed layer produces.  That is the input `windowQuotEquiv`'s widened
    84	analogue needs.
    85	
    86	It does **not** prove surjectivity of the widened evaluation (the right-exactness heart,
    87	`thetaGluedEval_surjective`'s analogue), and it does not produce a widened ε-value
    88	identity: those consume the widened certificate's (c2) clause through a widened
    89	`IsThetaPaired`, which is the next face and is *not* built here.  Read this as "the
    90	ε-value facts are now *stateable* over the widened carrier", not as a gate cleared.
    91	
    92	## Main declarations
    93	
    94	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.thetaOvlUnit` — the twisting unit of an ordered pair of
    95	  widened pieces, read off a `ChartTyping` rather than a `Sum` index.
    96	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.thetaGluedSubmodule` / `ThetaGlued` — the Θ-twisted
    97	  glued colength module over a widened cover, spelled as a kernel exactly as the
    98	  chart-typed one.
    99	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.thetaGluedEval` — the evaluation
   100	  `H⁰(𝒪(Θᵃ)) → W(d)^{Θᵃ}`.
   101	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.ker_thetaGluedEval` — **the kernel bridge**: the widened
   102	  kernel *is* the cover-independent vanishing submodule, hence literally the chart-typed
   103	  layer's kernel.
   104	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffAdaptation.windowCarve` / `ker_windowCarve` / `windowQuotEquiv` — the
   105	  bridge plugged in: the widened carve arrow's kernel is `divisorWindow d`, and (conditional on
   106	  surjectivity, which is **not** proved here) the quotient of the free window by it is the
   107	  widened `W(d)^{Θᵃ}`.  That last equivalence is the vehicle whose absence made the ε-value at a
   108	  `DivFamZarAff` unstateable.
   109	
   110	**A phrasing correction taken from a fresh-context review** (`I-0769`), because the wrong version
   111	was in this docstring: `ker_thetaGluedEval` does **not** show "`divisorWindow` is the same on both
   112	carriers" — `divisorWindow` takes only `d` and `hH1` and never mentioned a carrier, so that is
   113	vacuous.  The content runs the other way: *the widened evaluation's kernel lands on that
   114	already-fixed submodule.*
   115	-/

     8	/-!
     9	# DD-4 (Task 4, right exactness) — the trivialization bridges for `𝒪(Θᵃ − d)`
    10	
    11	The dictionary between sections of the glued theta-ideal sheaf
    12	(`DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealDatum`) and honest chart sections vanishing along the
    13	divisor family `d`:
    14	
    15	* `DivisorAdaptation.glued_cross` — **the cross-chart reading** of the glued matching:
    16	  for a glued section `s` and pieces `i` (chart 0), `j` (chart 1), on any open below
    17	  both, `f_i·s_i = θᵃ·(f_j·s_j)` — the transition units were built so that the piece
    18	  pictures assemble to a Θ-twisted pair.
    19	* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedSections_ext₀/₁` — a glued section over an open of a pinned
    20	  chart is determined by its components on the pieces of that chart (the other chart's
    21	  components are tied through `glued_cross` by regularity).
    22	* `DivisorAdaptation.idealToGlued₀/₁` — **trivialization**: a section `β` over `W ≤ Vc`
    23	  vanishing along `d` germwise divides by the equations into a glued section (the
    24	  chart-`c` picture; the other chart's components carry the `θ^{∓a}` factor), with the
    25	  characterizing equations `eqn_mul_idealToGlued₀_inl/inr` (and mirrors).
    26	* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedToIdeal₀/₁` — **assembly**: the piece pictures `f_i·s_i` of a
    27	  glued section over `W ≤ Vc` glue to a single section vanishing along `d`
    28	  (`res_gluedToIdeal₀`, `germ_gluedToIdeal₀_mem`, and mirrors).
    29	
    30	These four maps discharge the chart-lifting and overlap-correction inputs of
    31	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyThetaSurj` in
    32	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorThetaSurjectivity`.
    33	-/

    86	/-- The glued matching at a pair of indices, restricted to any open below the double
    87	overlap: `s_p = u_{pq} · s_q` on `O`. -/
    88	private lemma glued_matching_res {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    89	    (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W) (p q : (A.thetaIdealDatum a).index)
    90	    {O : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    91	    (hOW : O ≤ W) (hOp : O ≤ (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces p)
    92	    (hOq : O ≤ (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces q) :
    93	    (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOp) (s.val p)
    94	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOp hOq)
    95	          (((A.thetaIdealDatum a).unit p q :
    96	            Γ(relCurve C R, (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces p ⊓
    97	              (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces q)ˣ) :
    98	            Γ(relCurve C R, (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces p ⊓
    99	              (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces q))
   100	        * (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOq) (s.val q) := by
   101	  have hmatch := (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.mem_gluedSubmodule_iff R (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces
   102	    (A.thetaIdealDatum a).unit s.val).mp s.property p q
   103	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   104	    (le_inf (le_inf hOW hOp) hOq :
   105	      O ≤ W ⊓ (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces p ⊓ (A.thetaIdealDatum a).pieces q)) hmatch
   106	  rw [map_mul] at key
   107	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   108	  exact key

   110	/-- **The cross-chart reading of the glued matching**: for a chart-0 piece `i` and a
   111	chart-1 piece `j`, on any open below `W` and both pieces,
   112	`f_i·s_i = θᵃ·(f_j·s_j)` — the piece pictures of a glued section assemble to a
   113	Θ-twisted pair. -/
   114	lemma glued_cross {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W)
   115	    (i : Fin A.m₀) (j : Fin A.m₁) {O : (relCurve C R).Opens}
   116	    (hOW : O ≤ W) (hOi : O ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i)) (hOj : O ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)) :
   117	    (relCurve C R).resHom hOi (A.eqn (Sum.inl i))
   118	        * (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOi) (s.val (Sum.inl (ULift.up i)))
   119	      = (relCurve C R).resHom
   120	            (le_inf (hOi.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i)) (hOj.trans (A.pieces_inr_le j)))
   121	            ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
   122	              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   123	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
   124	              Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   125	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))
   126	          * ((relCurve C R).resHom hOj (A.eqn (Sum.inr j))
   127	            * (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOj) (s.val (Sum.inr (ULift.up j)))) := by
   128	  have key : (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOi) (s.val (Sum.inl (ULift.up i)))
   129	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOi hOj :
   130	            O ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j))
   131	          (((A.eqnRatio (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) :
   132	              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j))ˣ) :
   133	              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)))
   134	            * (relCurve C R).resHom
   135	                (inf_le_inf (A.pieces_inl_le i) (A.pieces_inr_le j))
   136	                ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
   137	                  Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   138	                    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
   139	                  Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   140	                    (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)))
   141	        * (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOj) (s.val (Sum.inr (ULift.up j))) :=
   142	    glued_matching_res s (Sum.inl (ULift.up i)) (Sum.inr (ULift.up j)) hOW hOi hOj
   143	  rw [map_mul, Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   144	  have hratio := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOi hOj :
   145	      O ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)))
   146	    (A.eqn_mul_eqnRatio (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j))
   147	  rw [map_mul] at hratio
   148	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hratio
   149	  rw [key, ← hratio]
   150	  ring

   152	/-- **Chart-0 determination**: a glued section over an open of the pinned chart `V₀` is
   153	determined by its chart-0 components. -/
   154	lemma gluedSections_ext₀ {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
   155	    (hW : W ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) {s t : A.ThetaIdealSections a W}
   156	    (h : ∀ i : Fin A.m₀, s.val (Sum.inl (ULift.up i)) = t.val (Sum.inl (ULift.up i))) :
   157	    s = t := by
   158	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun p => ?_)
   159	  rcases p with i | j
   160	  · exact h i.down
   161	  · -- the chart-1 components are tied through `glued_cross` on the chart-0 cover
   162	    apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (relCurve C R).sheaf
   163	      (fun i : Fin A.m₀ =>
   164	        W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i))
   165	      (W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down))
   166	      (fun i => homOfLE inf_le_left)
   167	    · intro x hx
   168	      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (A.cover₀ (hW hx.1))
   169	      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i, ⟨hx, hi⟩⟩
   170	    · intro i
   171	      change (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (s.val (Sum.inr j))
   172	        = (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (t.val (Sum.inr j))
   173	      have hOW : W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ≤ W :=
   174	        inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
   175	      have hOi : W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i)
   176	          ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) := inf_le_right
   177	      have hOj : W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i)
   178	          ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr j.down) := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
   179	      have hs := glued_cross s i j.down hOW hOi hOj
   180	      have ht := glued_cross t i j.down hOW hOi hOj
   181	      rw [h i] at hs
   182	      have hkey := hs.symm.trans ht
   183	      -- cancel the theta unit and the regular equation `f_j`
   184	      have hθ : IsUnit ((relCurve C R).resHom
   185	          (le_inf (hOi.trans (A.pieces_inl_le i)) (hOj.trans (A.pieces_inr_le j.down)))
   186	          ((relThetaCocycle C R π a :
   187	            Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   188	              (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :
   189	            Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊓
   190	              (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))) :=
   191	        (relThetaCocycle C R π a).isUnit.map _
   192	      have hcancel := hθ.mul_left_cancel hkey
   193	      have := A.eqn_res_cancel (Sum.inr j.down) hOj hcancel
   194	      -- both sides are the two componentwise restrictions
   195	      have hgoal : (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOj) (s.val (Sum.inr j))
   196	          = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOj) (t.val (Sum.inr j)) := this
   197	      calc (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (s.val (Sum.inr j))
   198	          = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOj) (s.val (Sum.inr j)) := rfl
   199	        _ = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOj) (t.val (Sum.inr j)) := hgoal
   200	        _ = (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (t.val (Sum.inr j)) := rfl

   202	/-- **Chart-1 determination**: a glued section over an open of the pinned chart `V₁` is
   203	determined by its chart-1 components. -/
   204	lemma gluedSections_ext₁ {W : (relCurve C R).Opens}
   205	    (hW : W ≤ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁) {s t : A.ThetaIdealSections a W}
   206	    (h : ∀ j : Fin A.m₁, s.val (Sum.inr (ULift.up j)) = t.val (Sum.inr (ULift.up j))) :
   207	    s = t := by
   208	  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun p => ?_)
   209	  rcases p with i | j
   210	  swap
   211	  · exact h j.down
   212	  · -- the chart-0 components are tied through `glued_cross` on the chart-1 cover
   213	    apply TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (relCurve C R).sheaf
   214	      (fun j : Fin A.m₁ =>
   215	        W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j))
   216	      (W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down))
   217	      (fun j => homOfLE inf_le_left)
   218	    · intro x hx
   219	      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (A.cover₁ (hW hx.1))
   220	      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨j, ⟨hx, hj⟩⟩
   221	    · intro j
   222	      change (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (s.val (Sum.inl i))
   223	        = (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (t.val (Sum.inl i))
   224	      have hOW : W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤ W :=
   225	        inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left
   226	      have hOi : W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)
   227	          ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right
   228	      have hOj : W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i.down) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j)
   229	          ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr j) := inf_le_right
   230	      have hs := glued_cross s i.down j hOW hOi hOj
   231	      have ht := glued_cross t i.down j hOW hOi hOj
   232	      rw [h j] at hs
   233	      have hkey := hs.trans ht.symm
   234	      have := A.eqn_res_cancel (Sum.inl i.down) hOi hkey
   235	      have hgoal : (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOi) (s.val (Sum.inl i))
   236	          = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOi) (t.val (Sum.inl i)) := this
   237	      calc (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (s.val (Sum.inl i))
   238	          = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOi) (s.val (Sum.inl i)) := rfl
   239	        _ = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOi) (t.val (Sum.inl i)) := hgoal
   240	        _ = (relCurve C R).resHom inf_le_left (t.val (Sum.inl i)) := rfl

   253	            O ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i'))

   255	              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i'))ˣ) :
   256	              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inl i) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl i')))

   258	        * (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOW hOi') (s.val (Sum.inl (ULift.up i'))) :=

   261	  have hratio := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOi hOi' :

   269	/-- **The same-chart reading of the glued matching** on chart 1. -/
   270	lemma glued_same₁ {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} (s : A.ThetaIdealSections a W)
   271	    (j j' : Fin A.m₁) {O : (relCurve C R).Opens}

   278	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_inf hOj hOj' :
   279	            O ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr j) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j'))
   280	          (((A.eqnRatio (Sum.inr j) (Sum.inr j') :
   281	              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces (Sum.inr j) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr j'))ˣ) :

    48	    (β : Γ(relCurve C R, W))

    53	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ A.pieces i ≤ W) β)
    54	        ∈ d.stalkIdeal z := by
    55	  intro z hz

    57	      ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_left : W ⊓ A.pieces i ≤ W) β)

    75	`f_i · (β/f_i) = β` on `O`. -/

    77	    (β : Γ(relCurve C R, W))

    79	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ W z hz).hom β ∈ d.stalkIdeal z)

   377	    (fun p : Fin A.m₀ × Fin A.m₁ =>
   378	      W ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inl p.1) ⊓ A.pieces (Sum.inr p.2)) W

   382	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (A.cover₁ ((hW hx).2))

   388	        ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inl i) := inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right

   390	        ≤ A.pieces (Sum.inr j) := inf_le_right

   392	      = (relCurve C R).resHom hOW

   396	                (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁)ˣ) :

     8	/-!
     9	# swallow-adapt on the widened cover: the straddling piece
    10	
    11	Roadmap leaf `AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-d.ddr.certificate.swallow-adapt`, restated over
    12	`AffCoverData`.  The chart-pair version (`DivSchemeCertZarChartPair.lean`) is landed but
    13	consumes chart principality, which is false for an arbitrary degree-`n` divisor on a curve of
    14	genus `≥ 1` (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 corrigendum C4(i)): `Cl(V_b) ≠ 0` and
    15	shrinking `Spec R` does not change a fibre class.  Over a widened cover the shape is
    16	different and the obstruction does not arise: **one piece swallows the support and every
    17	other piece misses it.**
    18	
    19	## The geometric input, supplied as a HYPOTHESIS and not re-derived
    20	
    21	The decision (I-0492 clause 2) says to USE, not re-derive: `supp D` is finite over `R`, hence
    22	lies in a single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`).  Mathlib has no form of
    23	`0B8B`, and this project constructs no curve other than `P¹`, so formalising it is out of
    24	scope for this lane.  It therefore appears here as the named, explicit hypothesis
    25	`SwallowedBy` — a *statement to be supplied by the seed*, exactly as
    26	`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 C4(ii) requires: the geometric input is relocated into a
    27	visible obligation rather than hidden inside a `LocalEquations` or an adaptation field.
    28	
    29	`SwallowedBy` is deliberately NOT bundled into `AffCoverData` or `AffAdaptation`.  A reader
    30	can see, from any theorem's signature, whether it assumes confinement.
    31	
    32	## What the shape buys
    33	
    34	For a cover with a straddling piece, swallow-or-miss holds by construction rather than by a
    35	connectivity argument, so — with no fibre, no tube, and no packet idempotent —
    36	`hnoLeak` holds at every piece, clause (c1)-finite holds at every piece, and every
    37	non-swallowing piece contributes a vanishing colength (`cert-collapse`).  Crucially there is
    38	no dichotomy step, hence no appeal to `V₀ ⊔ V₁ = ⊤`, hence no chart.
    39	
    40	## Main declarations
    41	
    42	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffCoverData.SwallowedBy` — the straddling-piece hypothesis.
    43	* `AffAdaptation.forall_subset_or_disjoint_of_swallowedBy` — swallow-or-miss from it.
    44	* `AffAdaptation.forall_noLeak_of_swallowedBy` — the assembler's `hnoLeak`.
    45	* `AffAdaptation.forall_finite_colength_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c1)-finite everywhere.
    46	* `AffCoverData.ofSwallowingPiece` — the two-piece widened cover from a straddling affine
    47	  open together with an affine open cover of the rest.
    48	-/

    67	/-- **The straddling-piece hypothesis** (the Stacks `0B8B` input, supplied not derived): some
    68	piece of the cover contains the whole support locus, and every other piece is disjoint from
    69	it.
    70	
    71	This is the widened replacement for "the support lies in `V₀ ⊓ V₁`".  The difference that
    72	matters: `V₀ ⊓ V₁` is the complement of a FIXED PAIR of vertical fibres and provably cannot
    73	always be arranged (ADDENDUM 4 §4.3 exhibits a straddling divisor at every genus `≥ 2`),
    74	whereas an affine open containing a support finite over `R` always exists. -/

   119	
   120	/-- **Every non-swallowing piece contributes nothing**: its colength vanishes, so clauses
   121	(c1) there are free (`cert-collapse`).  The certificate is carried by the straddling piece
   122	alone. -/
   123	theorem subsingleton_colength_of_ne_swallowing {j₀ : D.index}
   124	    (hmiss : ∀ j : D.index, j ≠ j₀ → Disjoint d.supportLocus (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
   125	    (j : D.index) (hj : j ≠ j₀) :
   126	    Subsingleton (A.colength j) :=
   127	  A.subsingleton_colength_of_disjoint_supportLocus j
   128	    (fun _ hz hsupp => (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss j hj)) hsupp hz)
   129	
   130	end AffAdaptation
   131	
   132	/-! ## Building a widened cover with a straddling piece -/
   133	
   134	namespace AffCoverData
   135	
   136	/-- **The widened cover from a straddling affine open plus a cover of the rest.** `W` is the
   137	affine open containing the support (the Stacks `0B8B` piece); `Ws` is any finite family of
   138	affine opens which, together with `W`, covers the curve.  The straddling condition itself is
   139	`SwallowedBy` and is a separate hypothesis — this constructor only assembles the cover. -/
   140	noncomputable def ofSwallowingPiece (W : (relCurve C R).Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
   141	    {m : ℕ} (Ws : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens) (hWs : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (Ws i))
   142	    (hcover : W ⊔ (⨆ i, Ws i) = ⊤) :
   143	    AffCoverData C R where
   144	  m := m + 1
   145	  pieces := Fin.snoc Ws W
   146	  isAffineOpen := fun j => by
   147	    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ ?_ j
   148	    · rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hW
   149	    · intro i; rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hWs i
   150	  cover := by
   151	    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => ?_
   152	    have hz : z ∈ W ⊔ (⨆ i, Ws i) := by rw [hcover]; trivial
   153	    rcases (Opens.mem_sup ..).mp hz with hzW | hzWs
   154	    · exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨Fin.last m, by rw [Fin.snoc_last]; exact hzW⟩
   155	    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hzWs
   156	      exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨i.castSucc, by rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact hi⟩
   157	
   158	end AffCoverData

     9	/-!
    10	# The glued clauses on a straddling cover: (c2)/(c3)/(c4) REDUCE to (c1)
    11	
    12	The corrected cert-collapse claim (roadmap `...certificate.cert-collapse`, as amended after
    13	the I-0340 refutation), carried out on the widened cover.
    14	
    15	## What was refuted and what survives
    16	
    17	The refuted claim was that (c2)/(c3)/(c4) are FREE for a swallow-or-miss adaptation.  They are
    18	not, and `DivisorFamilyAffCollapse.lean` kernel-checks why: `toOvlLeft i i = toOvlRight i i`
    19	by `rfl`, so every diagonal component of `deltaLeft - deltaRight` vanishes for EVERY
    20	adaptation, and the diagonal factor always survives in the cokernel.  Clause (c4) therefore
    21	always implies flatness of the diagonal overlap colengths — no structural observation about
    22	which pieces meet the support can remove that.
    23	
    24	What survives is the REDUCTION the amended node states: on a cover with a straddling piece,
    25	(c2)/(c3)/(c4) follow from (c1)-projectivity alone.  This file proves it.
    26	
    27	## The mechanism, and it is sharper than the node's account
    28	
    29	With a straddling piece `j₀`, every OTHER piece misses the support, so
    30	`subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint` kills every overlap colength that involves an index
    31	`≠ j₀` — in particular every OFF-DIAGONAL one, since a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least
    32	one entry `≠ j₀`.  Combined with the vanishing diagonal, `deltaLeft - deltaRight` is the ZERO
    33	map (`deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy`).  Hence:
    34	
    35	* `gluedSubmodule = ⊤`, so `Glued ≃ chartProd` — (c2) becomes a statement about the product of
    36	  the piece colengths, of which all but one are subsingleton;
    37	* `chartProd ⧸ gluedSubmodule` is subsingleton, so (c3) is free — and this IS free, with no
    38	  input, which is the one part of the original claim that was right;
    39	* `range (deltaLeft - deltaRight) = ⊥`, so the (c4) cokernel is `ovlProd` itself, whose
    40	  factors are the overlap colengths: all subsingleton except `ovlColength j₀ j₀`.  So (c4)
    41	  reduces to flatness of THAT ONE module — exactly the residue the refutation predicted, now
    42	  isolated to a single index instead of a whole cover.
    43	
    44	## Main declarations
    45	
    46	* `AffAdaptation.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy` — the difference arrow vanishes identically.
    47	* `AffAdaptation.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy` — the equalizer is everything.
    48	* `AffAdaptation.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy` — hence `Glued ≃ₗ chartProd`.
    49	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c3), unconditionally free.
    50	* `AffAdaptation.ovlColengthDiagEquiv` — the diagonal overlap colength IS the piece colength
    51	  (the cert-collapse node's "one technical lemma still needed", in the diagonal case).
    52	* `AffAdaptation.flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy` — clause (c4) from (c1)-flatness alone.
    53	* `AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy_of_c1` — **the capstone**: the whole certificate
    54	  from (c1) plus the rank datum.
    55	
    56	## The upshot for the roadmap
    57	
    58	`isCertified_of_swallowedBy` (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`) takes FIVE glued hypotheses.
    59	On a straddling cover none of them is needed: `isCertified_of_swallowedBy_of_c1` takes (c1)
    60	finiteness and projectivity, plus `hrank`, and produces all seven clauses.  `hrank` is the
    61	honest content of "the divisor has degree `n`" and cannot come from anywhere else.
    62	
    63	That is the corrected cert-collapse claim, discharged.  Note what it does NOT do: it does not
    64	contradict the I-0340 refutation.  (c4) still *implies* flatness of the diagonal overlap
    65	colengths — the refutation is a theorem.  What the straddling shape adds is that this
    66	implication is now harmless, because on the diagonal that flatness IS (c1)-flatness, which the
    67	fibrewise input already supplies.  The refutation said "(c4) is not free"; it is still not
    68	free, it is just no longer an extra assumption.
    69	-/
    70

    85	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

    89	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    90	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    91	variable {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    92	variable (A : AffAdaptation D d)
    93	
    94	/-! ## Every overlap colength off the straddling diagonal vanishes -/
    95	
    96	/-- **An overlap involving a missing piece has vanishing colength.**  `SwallowedBy` says every
    97	piece other than `j₀` is disjoint from the support, and an overlap is contained in each of its
    98	two pieces, so it too misses the support. -/
    99	lemma subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy {j₀ : D.index}
   100	    (hmiss : ∀ j : D.index, j ≠ j₀ →
   101	      Disjoint d.supportLocus (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C R)))
   102	    (i j : D.index) (h : i ≠ j₀ ∨ j ≠ j₀) :
   103	    Subsingleton (A.ovlColength i j) := by
   104	  refine A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_disjoint i j fun z hz hsupp => ?_
   105	  rcases h with hi | hj
   106	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss i hi)) hsupp hz.1
   107	  · exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (hmiss j hj)) hsupp hz.2
   108	
   109	/-- **The difference arrow is identically zero on a straddling cover.**  On the diagonal it
   110	vanishes for every adaptation whatsoever (`deltaSub_apply_diag`, the I-0340 fact); off the
   111	diagonal the target is subsingleton, because a pair `(i, j)` with `i ≠ j` has at least one
   112	entry different from the straddling index. -/
   113	theorem deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   114	    A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight = 0 := by
   115	  obtain ⟨j₀, _, hmiss⟩ := h
   116	  refine LinearMap.ext fun s => funext fun p => ?_
   117	  by_cases hp : p.1 = p.2
   118	  · -- diagonal: zero for every adaptation, by proof irrelevance on `inf_le_left/right`
   119	    obtain ⟨i, j⟩ := p
   120	    cases hp
   121	    exact A.deltaSub_apply_diag s i
   122	  · -- off-diagonal: at least one index misses the support, so the target is trivial
   123	    haveI : Subsingleton (A.ovlColength p.1 p.2) := by
   124	      by_cases h1 : p.1 = j₀
   125	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2
   126	          (Or.inr fun h2 => hp (h1.trans h2.symm))
   127	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss p.1 p.2 (Or.inl h1)
   128	    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
   129	
   130	/-! ## The consequences for (c2)/(c3)/(c4) -/
   131	
   132	/-- **The equalizer is everything**: with the difference arrow zero, every section glues. -/
   133	theorem gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   134	    A.gluedSubmodule = ⊤ := by
   135	  rw [gluedSubmodule, A.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy h]
   136	  exact LinearMap.ker_zero
   137	
   138	/-- **Hence the glued module is the whole product of piece colengths.**  This is what makes
   139	(c2) a statement about the piece colengths — of which, on a straddling cover, all but the
   140	swallowing one are subsingleton. -/
   141	noncomputable def gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   142	    A.Glued ≃ₗ[R] A.chartProd :=
   143	  (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h)).trans
   144	    Submodule.topEquiv
   145	
   146	/-- **Clause (c3) is free on a straddling cover** — no fibrewise input, no Noetherian
   147	hypothesis, nothing.  The inclusion `W(d) ↪ ∏ colength` is onto, so its cokernel is trivial.
   148	This is the one part of this leaf's refuted original claim that was correct. -/
   149	theorem flat_coker_incl_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d) :
   150	    Module.Flat R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
   151	  haveI : Subsingleton (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) := by
   152	    rw [A.gluedSubmodule_eq_top_of_swallowedBy h]; infer_instance
   153	  haveI : Module.Free R (A.chartProd ⧸ A.gluedSubmodule) :=
   154	    Module.Free.of_subsingleton R _
   155	  exact Module.Flat.of_free
   156	
   157	/-- **Clause (c2)-finiteness reduces to the piece colengths.** -/
   158	theorem finite_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   159	    (hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (A.colength j)) :
   160	    Module.Finite R A.Glued := by
   161	  haveI := hfin
   162	  haveI : Module.Finite R A.chartProd := Module.Finite.pi
   163	  exact Module.Finite.equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm
   164	
   165	/-- **Clause (c2)-projectivity reduces to the piece colengths.**  The index is a `Fin`, so the
   166	product is the direct sum and `Module.Projective.directSum` applies. -/
   167	theorem projective_glued_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   168	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
   169	    Module.Projective R A.Glued := by
   170	  haveI := hproj
   171	  haveI : Module.Projective R A.chartProd :=
   172	    Module.Projective.of_equiv
   173	      (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R D.index A.colength)
   174	  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv (A.gluedEquivChartProd_of_swallowedBy h).symm
   175	
   176	/-! ### The diagonal overlap IS the piece colength
   177	
   178	The identification the cert-collapse node calls "the one technical lemma still needed", in the
   179	only case the straddling shape leaves: the diagonal.  It is easier there than in general
   180	(`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` needs no unit argument, only `inf_idem`) but it is NOT
   181	definitional — `Γ(pieces i ⊓ pieces i)` and `Γ(pieces i)` are different types, which is the
   182	`inf`-bookkeeping hazard the node flags.  So it goes through a genuine algebra equivalence. -/
   183	
   184	/-- The opens-level idempotence, named so the transports below can rewrite with it. -/
   185	lemma pieces_inf_self (i : D.index) : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i = D.pieces i := inf_idem _
   186	
   187	/-- **The diagonal overlap colength is the piece colength.**  Restriction along
   188	`pieces i ⊓ pieces i = pieces i` is an algebra isomorphism carrying the overlap ideal — whose
   189	two generators coincide there — onto `span {eqn i}`. -/
   190	noncomputable def sectionsInfSelfEquiv (i : D.index) :
   191	    Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i) ≃ₐ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i) where
   192	  toFun := relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i).symm)
   193	  invFun := relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i))
   194	  left_inv := fun x => by
   195	    rw [relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
   196	      ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
   197	    simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
   198	      (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
   199	        (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
   200	  right_inv := fun x => by
   201	    rw [relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
   202	      ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
   203	    simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
   204	      (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
   205	        (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
   206	  map_mul' := map_mul _
   207	  map_add' := map_add _
   208	  commutes' := AlgHom.commutes _
   209	
   210	@[simp]
   211	lemma sectionsInfSelfEquiv_apply (i : D.index)
   212	    (x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i)) :
   213	    sectionsInfSelfEquiv (C := C) (R := R) (D := D) i x
   214	      = relResAlgHom C R (le_of_eq (pieces_inf_self i).symm) x := rfl
   215	
   216	/-- **Restricting to the diagonal overlap and coming back is the identity.**  Stated as a
   217	`simp` lemma because the two coercions (`AlgEquiv` vs the `RingHom` that `Ideal.map` takes)
   218	are not syntactically equal, so `rw` cannot use the unstated form. -/
   219	@[simp]
   220	lemma sectionsInfSelfEquiv_relResAlgHom (i : D.index)
   221	    (h : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ D.pieces i) (x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)) :
   222	    sectionsInfSelfEquiv (C := C) (R := R) (D := D) i (relResAlgHom C R h x) = x := by
   223	  rw [sectionsInfSelfEquiv_apply, relResAlgHom_apply, relResAlgHom_apply,
   224	    ← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
   225	  simpa using congrFun (congrArg (fun f => (CommRingCat.Hom.hom f))
   226	    (congrArg (relCurve C R).presheaf.map
   227	      (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op (Subsingleton.elim _ (homOfLE le_rfl))))) x
   228	
   229	/-- The same identity in the `RingHom`-coerced spelling that `Ideal.map` produces.  Both
   230	spellings are needed: `Ideal.map` takes the ring-hom coercion of the equivalence, and `rw`
   231	does not see through the difference. -/
   232	lemma sectionsInfSelfEquiv_ringHom_relResAlgHom (i : D.index)
   233	    (h : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ D.pieces i) (x : Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)) :
   234	    ((sectionsInfSelfEquiv (C := C) (R := R) (D := D) i :
   235	        Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces i) →+* Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i)))
   236	      (relResAlgHom C R h x) = x :=
   237	  sectionsInfSelfEquiv_relResAlgHom i h x
   238	
   239	/-- **The diagonal overlap colength is the piece colength.**  The overlap ideal at `(i, i)` is
   240	generated by the two restrictions of `eqn i` along `inf_le_left` and `inf_le_right` — which at
   241	`pieces i ⊓ pieces i` are the same proof of the same inequality, so the ideal is the span of a
   242	single element, and `sectionsInfSelfEquiv` carries it to `span {eqn i}`. -/
   243	noncomputable def ovlColengthDiagEquiv (i : D.index) :
   244	    A.ovlColength i i ≃ₐ[R] A.colength i :=
   245	  Ideal.quotientEquivAlg (A.ovlIdeal i i) (Ideal.span {A.eqn i})
   246	    (sectionsInfSelfEquiv i)
   247	    (by
   248	      rw [AffAdaptation.ovlIdeal, Ideal.map_span]
   249	      refine congrArg (Ideal.span) ?_
   250	      simp only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
   251	      rw [sectionsInfSelfEquiv_ringHom_relResAlgHom i inf_le_left (A.eqn i)]
   252	      exact (Set.pair_eq_singleton (A.eqn i)).symm)
   253	
   254	/-- Hence flatness of the piece colengths gives flatness of the diagonal overlaps. -/
   255	theorem flat_ovlColength_diag_of_flat_colength (i : D.index)
   256	    [Module.Flat R (A.colength i)] :
   257	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i i) :=
   258	  Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (A.ovlColengthDiagEquiv i).toLinearEquiv
   259	
   260	/-- **Clause (c4) reduces to flatness of the piece colengths alone.**  The difference arrow is
   261	zero, so its cokernel is `ovlProd` itself; every off-`j₀` factor is subsingleton, and the
   262	surviving factor `ovlColength j₀ j₀` is the diagonal overlap of the straddling piece, whose
   263	flatness is what the refutation identified as unavoidable.  It is supplied here as `hdiag`,
   264	one module rather than a whole cover — which is precisely the reduction the amended
   265	cert-collapse node claims. -/
   266	theorem flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy' (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   267	    (hdiag : ∀ i j : D.index, Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i j)) :
   268	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) := by
   269	  haveI : ∀ p : D.index × D.index, Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength p.1 p.2) :=
   270	    fun p => hdiag p.1 p.2
   271	  haveI : Module.Flat R A.ovlProd := Module.Flat.pi_of_finite
   272	  have hrange : LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight) = ⊥ := by
   273	    rw [A.deltaSub_eq_zero_of_swallowedBy h]; exact LinearMap.range_zero
   274	  rw [hrange]
   275	  exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot ⊥ rfl)
   276	
   277	/-- **Every overlap colength is flat, from (c1)-flatness alone.**  Two cases, exhausting the
   278	pairs: off the diagonal at least one index misses the support (straddling), so the overlap
   279	colength is subsingleton hence free; on the diagonal it IS the piece colength, by
   280	`ovlColengthDiagEquiv`.  This removes the last non-(c1) input from clause (c4). -/
   281	theorem flat_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   282	    (hflat : ∀ j, Module.Flat R (A.colength j)) (i j : D.index) :
   283	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlColength i j) := by
   284	  obtain ⟨j₀, _, hmiss⟩ := h
   285	  by_cases hij : i = j
   286	  · subst hij
   287	    haveI := hflat i
   288	    exact A.flat_ovlColength_diag_of_flat_colength i
   289	  · haveI : Subsingleton (A.ovlColength i j) := by
   290	      by_cases h1 : i = j₀
   291	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss i j
   292	          (Or.inr fun h2 => hij (h1.trans h2.symm))
   293	      · exact A.subsingleton_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy hmiss i j (Or.inl h1)
   294	    haveI : Module.Free R (A.ovlColength i j) := Module.Free.of_subsingleton R _
   295	    exact Module.Flat.of_free
   296	
   297	/-- **Clause (c4) from (c1)-flatness alone**, on a straddling cover.  No overlap input. -/
   298	theorem flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy (h : D.SwallowedBy d)
   299	    (hflat : ∀ j, Module.Flat R (A.colength j)) :
   300	    Module.Flat R (A.ovlProd ⧸ LinearMap.range (A.deltaLeft - A.deltaRight)) :=
   301	  A.flat_coker_diff_of_swallowedBy' h (A.flat_ovlColength_of_swallowedBy h hflat)
   302	
   303	/-! ## The capstone: a certificate from (c1) and the rank alone
   304	
   305	This is what the reduction is FOR.  `DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`'s
   306	`isCertified_of_swallowedBy` had to take (c2)/(c3)/(c4) as hypotheses, because in general
   307	they are not free.  On a straddling cover they are not hypotheses at all: they follow from
   308	(c1) plus the flatness of the overlap colengths and the rank input. -/
   309	
   310	/-- **The full certificate on a straddling cover, from piece-level data only.**  Compare
   311	`AffAdaptation.isCertified_of_swallowedBy` (`DivisorFamilyAffAssemble.lean`), which takes five
   312	glued hypotheses; here the only non-(c1) inputs are the overlap flatness the I-0340 refutation
   313	proved unavoidable, and the rank/degree datum `hrank`, which is the honest content of "the
   314	divisor has degree `n`" and cannot come from anywhere else.
   315

   121	affine open the `0B8B` datum produced, rather than about the glued module over the whole cover.
   122

   135	    (fun p => (A.rankAtStalk_glued_eq_of_swallowedBy hsub hmiss hfin hproj p).trans (hrank p))

   137	/-- **Non-vacuity of the one-piece rank datum** (trap (c) of the workspace axiom-probe
   138	catalogue, inbox `I-0442`: a theorem whose named hypothesis cannot hold is vacuously true and

   140	misses the support, so its colength vanishes and the datum holds with `n = 0`.
   141	
   142	Not a useful instance, but it certifies that `hrank` at `j₀` is satisfiable, so the reduction
   143	above is a reduction rather than a statement about nothing. -/
   144	theorem rankAtStalk_colength_eq_zero_of_supportLocus_empty
   145	    (hempty : d.supportLocus = (∅ : Set (relCurve C R))) (j₀ : D.index)
   146	    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
   147	    Module.rankAtStalk (R := R) (A.colength j₀) p = 0 :=

   149	    (by rw [hempty]; exact Set.empty_disjoint _) p

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffFibreData
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffThetaKernelGlobal
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorThetaSheafSequence
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeCertificateEngine

/-!
# The global theta cokernel and the widened intrinsic range

A widened certificate supplies fibrewise vanishing for `O(a Theta - d)`.  After choosing
an auxiliary chart presentation of the same local equations, the existing rigid engine
turns those witnesses into vanishing of the first cohomology of its theta-ideal sheaf.
The canonical sheaf inclusion from `DivisorThetaSheafSequence` therefore has a surjective
cokernel projection on global sections.

The range of that inclusion on global sections is exactly the cover-independent vanishing
submodule.  Hence the cokernel is canonically the same quotient already identified with
the range of intrinsic widened theta evaluation.  No chart typing of the widened cover and
no additional hypothesis occur.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]

attribute [local instance] instOverCleftWFT

namespace DivisorAdaptation

variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}

/-- On global sections, the sheaf inclusion is the established junction from the
theta-ideal datum to the cover-independent vanishing submodule. -/
theorem thetaIdealInclApp_top_eq_gluedToVanishing (B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
    (a : ℕ) (s : B.ThetaIdealSections a ⊤) :
    B.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) ⊤ s =
      ((B.gluedToVanishingₗ a s :
        d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)) :
        relThetaSections C R π a) := by
  rfl

/-- The pointwise range of the theta-ideal sheaf inclusion on global sections is exactly
the intrinsic, cover-independent divisor-family vanishing submodule. -/
theorem range_thetaIdealInclApp_top (B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d) (a : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.range (B.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) ⊤) =
      d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    rw [thetaIdealInclApp_top_eq_gluedToVanishing C R π B a s]
    exact (B.gluedToVanishingₗ a s).property
  · intro hx
    let y : ↥(d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
        (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a)) := ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨(B.gluedEquivVanishing a).symm y, ?_⟩
    rw [thetaIdealInclApp_top_eq_gluedToVanishing C R π B]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((B.gluedEquivVanishing a).apply_symm_apply y)

end DivisorAdaptation

section CokernelGlobal

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable [IsDominant π] [IsIntegral C.left]

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]

namespace AffAdaptation

/-- A widened high-window certificate produces an auxiliary chart presentation of the
same equations whose theta-ideal sheaf has vanishing first cohomology. -/
theorem IsCertified.exists_chartAdaptation_subsingleton_thetaIdealH1
    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : ℕ} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    {a : ℕ} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
    (hMa : windowM_choice π hπ g ≤ a) :
    ∃ B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d,
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (B.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf 1) := by
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := exists_divisorAdaptation C R π d
  refine ⟨B, (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff (B.thetaIdealDatum a)).mp
    (datum_subsingleton_pairH1 (B.thetaIdealDatum a) hπ ?_)⟩
  apply B.thetaIdealDatum_hfib_of_witness a
  intro p
  obtain ⟨W, hWclass, hWH1⟩ :=
    hc.fibrewise_thetaSub_h1_witness C R π hπ hO hχ ha1 hMa p
  refine ⟨W, ?_, hWH1⟩
  rw [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_baseChange,
    B.cechPicClass_thetaIdealDatum]
  exact hWclass

/-- The same producer in the form consumed by the global cokernel projection. -/
theorem IsCertified.exists_chartAdaptation_thetaIdealCokernel_app_top_surjective
    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : ℕ} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    {a : ℕ} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
    (hMa : windowM_choice π hπ g ≤ a) :
    ∃ B : DivisorAdaptation C R π d,
      Function.Surjective
        ((cokernel.π (DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealIncl (A := B) (a := a))).hom.app
          (op (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens))).hom := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hc.exists_chartAdaptation_subsingleton_thetaIdealH1
    C R π hπ hO hχ ha1 hMa
  letI : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (B.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf 1) := hB
  exact ⟨B, B.thetaIdealCokernel_app_top_surjective⟩

end AffAdaptation

namespace AffAdaptation

/-- Once the widened certificate supplies the auxiliary theta-ideal `H¹` vanishing,
global sections of the quotient sheaf for the chosen auxiliary chart are linearly equivalent
to the actual range of the intrinsic widened theta evaluation. -/
noncomputable def IsCertified.thetaIdealCokernelEquivIntrinsicRange
    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
    {A : AffAdaptation D d} {g : ℕ} (hc : A.IsCertified g)
    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    {a : ℕ} (ha1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
    (hMa : windowM_choice π hπ g ≤ a) :
    let B := Classical.choose
      (hc.exists_chartAdaptation_subsingleton_thetaIdealH1 C R π hπ hO hχ ha1 hMa)
    (cokernel (DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealIncl (A := B) (a := a))).obj.obj
        (op (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens)) ≃ₗ[R]
      ↥(LinearMap.range (A.intrinsicThetaEvalRel (π := π) a)) := by
  let hB := Classical.choose_spec
    (hc.exists_chartAdaptation_subsingleton_thetaIdealH1 C R π hπ hO hχ ha1 hMa)
  let B := Classical.choose
    (hc.exists_chartAdaptation_subsingleton_thetaIdealH1 C R π hπ hO hχ ha1 hMa)
  letI : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (B.thetaIdealDatum a).sheaf 1) := hB
  have hrange :
      LinearMap.range
          ((DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealIncl (A := B) (a := a)).hom.app
            (op (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens))).hom =
        d.vanishingSubmodule R (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
          (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ (relThetaCocycle C R π a) := by
    rw [DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealIncl_app]
    change LinearMap.range (B.thetaIdealInclApp (a := a) ⊤) = _
    exact DivisorAdaptation.range_thetaIdealInclApp_top C R π B a
  exact (Sheaf.cokernelAppEquivQuotientRange
      (DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealIncl (A := B) (a := a))
      (op (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens)) B.thetaIdealCokernel_app_top_surjective).trans
    ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ hrange).trans
      (A.intrinsicThetaQuotEquivRange (π := π) a))

/-- The global theta quotient maps injectively into the widened intrinsic descent module.
The remaining representability seam is exactly the assertion that this map is surjective. -/
noncomputable def IsCertified.thetaIdealCokernelToIntrinsic
    {D : AffCoverData C R} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}

/-- The left quotient restriction as a semilinear map over the corresponding colength
algebra restriction.  This is the left half of the intrinsic theta descent datum. -/
noncomputable def thetaToOverlapLeftColength (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    (i j : D.index) :
    A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a i →ₛₗ[(A.toOvlLeft i j).toRingHom]
      A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j where

    (i j : D.index) :

      A.ThetaOverlapQuotient (π := π) a i j where
  toFun := A.thetaToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j
  map_add' := (A.thetaToOverlapRight (π := π) a i j).map_add
  map_smul' := A.thetaToOverlapRight_smul (π := π) a i j

/-- Evaluation of the widened equalizer algebra on one piece colength algebra. -/
noncomputable def gluedSubalgebraPieceMap (A : AffAdaptation D d) (j : D.index) :
    ↥(gluedSubalgebra A) →ₐ[R] A.colength j :=
  (Pi.evalAlgHom R (fun i : D.index => A.colength i) j).comp
    (gluedSubalgebra A).val

/-- A piece theta quotient is a module over the widened equalizer algebra by evaluation on
that piece. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def thetaPieceQuotientGluedModule (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ)
    (j : D.index) :
    Module ↥(gluedSubalgebra A) (A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a j) :=
  letI : Module (A.colength j) (A.ThetaPieceQuotient (π := π) a j) :=
    A.thetaPieceQuotientModule (π := π) a j

    (A.gluedSubalgebraPieceMap j).toRingHom

/-- The intrinsic theta equalizer is stable under the widened equalizer algebra `A_D`. -/
noncomputable def intrinsicThetaGluedOver (A : AffAdaptation D d) (a : ℕ) :
    Submodule ↥(gluedSubalgebra A) (A.ThetaPieceProd (π := π) a) where
  carrier := A.intrinsicThetaGluedSubmodule (π := π) a
  add_mem' := fun hx hy => (A.intrinsicThetaGluedSubmodule (π := π) a).add_mem hx hy

  smul_mem' := by

    have hx' := (A.mem_intrinsicThetaGluedSubmodule_iff (π := π) a x).mp hx
    apply (A.mem_intrinsicThetaGluedSubmodule_iff (π := π) a (c • x)).mpr
    intro p
    change A.thetaToOverlapLeft (π := π) a p.1 p.2 (c.1 p.1 • x p.1) =

    rw [A.thetaToOverlapLeft_smul, A.thetaToOverlapRight_smul]

/-!
# DD-4 (Task 4, right exactness) — the trivialization bridges for `𝒪(Θᵃ − d)`

The dictionary between sections of the glued theta-ideal sheaf
(`DivisorAdaptation.thetaIdealDatum`) and honest chart sections vanishing along the
divisor family `d`:

* `DivisorAdaptation.glued_cross` — **the cross-chart reading** of the glued matching:
  for a glued section `s` and pieces `i` (chart 0), `j` (chart 1), on any open below
  both, `f_i·s_i = θᵃ·(f_j·s_j)` — the transition units were built so that the piece
  pictures assemble to a Θ-twisted pair.
* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedSections_ext₀/₁` — a glued section over an open of a pinned
  chart is determined by its components on the pieces of that chart (the other chart's
  components are tied through `glued_cross` by regularity).
* `DivisorAdaptation.idealToGlued₀/₁` — **trivialization**: a section `β` over `W ≤ Vc`
  vanishing along `d` germwise divides by the equations into a glued section (the
  chart-`c` picture; the other chart's components carry the `θ^{∓a}` factor), with the
  characterizing equations `eqn_mul_idealToGlued₀_inl/inr` (and mirrors).
* `DivisorAdaptation.gluedToIdeal₀/₁` — **assembly**: the piece pictures `f_i·s_i` of a
  glued section over `W ≤ Vc` glue to a single section vanishing along `d`
  (`res_gluedToIdeal₀`, `germ_gluedToIdeal₀_mem`, and mirrors).

These four maps discharge the chart-lifting and overlap-correction inputs of
`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyThetaSurj` in
`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorThetaSurjectivity`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  [Algebra k R]
